answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 60956 Country: India Title: can woman pray EID namaz alone or beside a woman imam? Question: In our city a woman goes to pray the namaz of Eid in a masjid. And there the whole women pray namaz beside a woman imam. Is it right? If no, then can they pray Eid namaz alone at home or not? Answer ID: 60956 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1049/1049/M=11/1436) A jamah in which both the imam and muqtadis are only women is makrooh tahrimi whether it is Eid salah or five times salah. Jama’ah is a precondition for the validity of Eid salahs, it is not lawful to offer Eid salahs at home alone. So Eid salah cannot be offered alone. Moreover, the salah of Jumuah and Eidain are not wajib on women. Hence this practice of the women in your city who go to offer Eid salah and offer salah behind lady imam is not correct. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
